title: Alien holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- alien body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='22' ry='24' fill='#5cd65c'/>
  <!-- belly lighter shade -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='13' ry='14' fill='#a8f0a8'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='18' ry='16' fill='#5cd65c'/>
  <!-- head highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='30' rx='11' ry='9' fill='#8cee8c'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='34' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#1a1a4a'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='34' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#1a1a4a'/>
  <!-- eye glows -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='32' r='2' fill='#9fd8ff'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='32' r='2' fill='#9fd8ff'/>
  <!-- antennae -->
  <line x1='40' y1='20' x2='34' y2='10' stroke='#5cd65c' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='8' r='3.5' fill='#ffcc33'/>
  <line x1='60' y1='20' x2='66' y2='10' stroke='#5cd65c' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='8' r='3.5' fill='#ffcc33'/>
  <!-- mouth smile -->
  <path d='M44 42 Q50 48 56 42' stroke='#1a1a4a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <line x1='29' y1='58' x2='18' y2='48' stroke='#5cd65c' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='71' y1='58' x2='82' y2='48' stroke='#5cd65c' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- hands -->
  <circle cx='17' cy='47' r='4' fill='#8cee8c'/>
  <circle cx='83' cy='47' r='4' fill='#8cee8c'/>
  <!-- heart held above hands -->
  <path d='M50 34 
           C50 34 42 26 36 32 
           C30 38 36 46 50 54 
           C64 46 70 38 64 32 
           C58 26 50 34 50 34 Z' 
        fill='#ff4466'/>
  <!-- heart highlight -->
  <path d='M44 33 
           C44 33 40 30 38 33 
           C36 36 40 39 44 42' 
        stroke='#ff99aa' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='86' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#5cd65c'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='86' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#5cd65c'/>
</svg>
